about.description: Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.

name: v0.55.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(generation): keep knowledge-graph layer names unique by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2725
* fix(mcp): stop listing the test layer as an architecture layer by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2726
* fix(mcp): share get_context's budget across targets instead of dropping one by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2727
* fix(mcp): return the repo='all' error dict from get_health and the finding tools by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2728
* fix(ui): read the tiered get_dead_code shape in the chat card by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2729
* feat(ui): show the owner's line share and the merge commit count by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2730
* feat(ui): a steps-unavailable state in the opportunity drawer by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2732
* feat(ui): name the worst test file and mark unverified findings by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2733
* feat(present): tell the repository as a short story by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2734
* docs: correct stale MCP tool reference entries and document savings sync by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2724
* perf(mcp): build get_answer's graph projections once per index state by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2735
* fix(mcp): read a typed identifier as one name in get_answer retrieval by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2736
* fix(mcp): answer 'what happens when' questions from the entry's call order by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2737
* fix(persistence): a data step that moves no rows no longer fails the schema upgrade by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2738
* docs: bring the dashboard Architecture and Code Health tab lists up to date by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2731
* fix(mcp): accept get_risk(changed_files=[...]) without targets by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2761
* perf(mcp): read only the targets' graph neighbourhood in get_risk by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2763
* fix(update): stop the first update after init rebuilding every page by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2765
* fix(go): a chained call on an external return type is not a bare-name call by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2766
* fix(go): type a call through a struct field from the field's declaration by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2767
* fix(core): type a nested class's fields and ancestors from its own symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2768
* perf(dead-code): read stored findings instead of re-parsing the repo by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2769
* perf(search): write full-text pages in fixed-size chunks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2780
* fix(cpp): a static function in another translation unit is not a call target by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2770
* fix(java): record package-private access instead of public by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2771
* fix(typescript): give object-literal methods their own symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2772
* fix(python): resolve super() calls through the MRO, not the file's last same name by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2773
* fix(cpp): a function that returns a pointer or a reference is a symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2774
* fix(core): a parameter or local shadows a bare call's module-level target by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2775
* refactor(actions): build RepoFacts from plain rows in a pure core builder by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2752
* fix(go): type a local from the call that declares it by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2777
* fix(csharp): resolve calls between fragments of a partial class by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2776
* fix(go): type a range loop variable from the container it walks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2778
* fix(core): resolve a member call once, by its receiver first by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2779
* fix(rust): type a receiver from its annotation or constructor call by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2800
* docs(mcp): list every opt-in tool and stop calling workspace tools automatic by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2759
* docs(languages): match the extension and import-resolution rows to the language specs by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2760
* docs(health): document lazy_load_in_loop, current marker counts and a split_file id limit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2815
* ci: send unit test coverage to the pull request bot by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2809
* fix(core): give each Java and C# overload its own symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2811
* fix(health): name the opportunity lookup flag found, not resolved by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2812
* fix(cli): read the stored refactoring queue for health --refactoring-targets by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2813
* fix(health): class schema migrations as tooling in the performance context by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2814
* fix(refactoring): credit the share of a finding a plan actually removes by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2816
* fix(perf): a C# task read after it was awaited does not block by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2823
* feat(health): store each file's code origin and per-function dispatch and deprecation facts by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2820
* feat(health): one Fix first queue across defect, maintainability and performance by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2821
* fix(php): a name that only appears in a docblock does not form an import cycle by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2824
* fix(java): refuse a call on a receiver typed to a library class by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2827
* fix(cpp): give each C++ overload its own symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2829
* fix(refactoring): give every plan writer the community labels a full index uses by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2830
* fix(health): keep finding triage across re-index by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2819
* feat(health): rank verification tests by how directly they exercise the change by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2825
* fix(plugins): carry the Fix first wording into the shared code-health skill source by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2836
* fix(dead-code): link Lambda handlers named in serverless, SAM and Terraform config by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2834
* fix(rust): resolve module paths and brace-group imports inside a crate by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2835
* fix(csharp): type each link of a chained call from the one before by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2833
* feat(performance): one opportunity per place you change, ranked by value by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2817
* feat(ui): lead Code Health with Fix first and put the code in the plan drawers by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2831

* feat(ui): plot the whole filtered set on the Findings impact and effort graph by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2832
* feat(health): Fix first applies the baseline precision levers and says why in plain words by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2839
* fix(health): close out Fix first: perf lines, refactoring default scope, plain text by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2841
